test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 5th March 2009 is Thursday, then what day of the week will be on 11th March 2016?
solution: Given: **5th March 2009** was Thursday. Now, 2009 to 2016 = 7 Years (5 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years). And, In 7 Years = 2 Leap Years and 5 Ordinary Years. So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days, And, 5 Ordinary Years have 5 odd days.
